name: al-rawi
description: Al-Rawi monorepo tooling: git hooks, commit conventions and cross-stack developer scripts

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm --dir frontend install && uv --directory backend sync --all-groups
scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir frontend run check && pnpm --dir frontend run typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.check:api: uv --directory backend run ruff check . && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check . && uv --directory backend run pytest -q
scripts.fix: pnpm --dir frontend exec biome check --write . && uv --directory backend run ruff check --fix . && uv --directory backend run ruff format .
